groups.title: Interactive Workspace
groups.description: RING-5 provides an isolated interactive workspace for navigating, inspecting, and resetting an analysis session.

groups.title: Data Ingestion and Parsing
groups.description: RING-5 loads tabular data and discovers and parses simulator statistics without hiding incomplete or failed input.

groups.title: Dataset Management
groups.description: RING-5 inspects and transforms the shared workspace dataset through previewable, non-mutating operations.

groups.title: Per-Plot Data Shaping
groups.description: RING-5 builds independent ordered transformation pipelines for each plot.

groups.title: Plot Lifecycle
groups.description: RING-5 manages multiple independently configured plots within one workspace.

groups.title: Plot Types
groups.description: RING-5 offers registry-backed plot types for comparisons, trends, distributions, and matrix views.

groups.title: Figure Configuration
groups.description: RING-5 exposes publication-oriented layout, styling, labeling, ordering, and annotation controls.

groups.title: Rendering and Export
groups.description: RING-5 renders engine-independent plot traces through Plotly or Matplotlib and exports publication artifacts.

groups.title: Reproducibility and Portfolios
groups.description: RING-5 snapshots, migrates, restores, and replays complete figure portfolios.

groups.title: Automation API and CLI
groups.description: RING-5 exposes supported Python and command-line workflows for headless analysis and CI.

groups.title: Extensibility, Safety, and Quality
groups.description: RING-5 keeps extension points discoverable while enforcing integrity, security, lifecycle, and architecture constraints.

groups.title: Feature Traceability
groups.description: RING-5 maintains a generated OpenFastTrace catalog that detects untracked current and future capabilities.

features.title: Streamlit analysis workspace
features.description: The application shall provide a wide-layout Streamlit workspace that composes data, plotting, portfolio, and documentation workflows.

features.title: Page navigation
features.description: Users shall navigate between Data Source, Data Managers, Manage Plots, Save/Load Portfolio, and Documentation pages from the sidebar.

features.title: Browser-session isolation
features.description: Each browser session shall own independent mutable data, parser, plot, preview, and history state while sharing only explicitly thread-safe process pools.

features.title: Workspace data metrics
features.description: When data is loaded, the workspace shall display its row count, column count, and source name.

features.title: Clear and reset session
features.description: Users shall be able to clear loaded data, plots, and session state from the sidebar without affecting other browser sessions.

features.title: In-application documentation hub
features.description: The application shall link users to canonical getting-started, workflow, guide, reference, and developer documentation.

features.title: Selectable data source modes
features.description: Users shall choose between parsing simulator output, using existing CSV data, and loading a recent CSV-pool entry.

features.title: CSV loading
features.description: RING-5 shall load an existing CSV into the active workspace through the web application or Session API.

features.title: Generic CSV contract
features.description: CSV input shall have a header and at least one data row, remain simulator-independent, and report malformed or empty input explicitly.

features.title: Recent CSV pool
features.description: Parsed and selected CSV files shall be discoverable in a recent-file pool that supports loading and removal.

features.title: Simulator registry
features.description: Data-source labels, patterns, strategies, and variable types shall be derived from registered simulator metadata.

features.title: gem5 parser backend
features.description: RING-5 shall provide a registered gem5 backend for scanning and parsing stats.txt output.

features.title: Pattern-based statistics discovery
features.description: The parser shall recursively discover regular files matching literal, glob, or regular-expression-aware statistics patterns within configured resource limits.

features.title: Statistics variable scan
features.description: RING-5 shall scan selected simulator files and aggregate discovered variable names, types, metadata, ranges, and visible per-file failures.

features.title: Asynchronous scan lifecycle
features.description: Scanning shall support submit, finalize, strict or partial result handling, cancellation, and ownership-safe cleanup through ScanJob.

features.title: Sampled and exhaustive scans
features.description: Users shall select an exact positive scan sample limit or use zero for exhaustive discovery up to the global file ceiling.

features.title: Scanned and manual variable configuration
features.description: Users shall search scanned variables or manually add, edit, type, rename, and remove parser variable configurations before parsing.

features.title: Scalar statistic parsing
features.description: The gem5 backend shall scan and parse scalar statistics, including exact names and supported regular-expression patterns.

features.title: Vector statistic parsing
features.description: The gem5 backend shall scan and expand vector statistics into deterministic indexed columns.

features.title: Distribution statistic parsing
features.description: The gem5 backend shall parse distribution summaries and preserve their configured fields without inventing unavailable values.

features.title: Histogram statistic parsing
features.description: The gem5 backend shall parse conventional ranges and pipe-delimited one-line histograms, expand buckets, and aggregate repeated matches.

features.title: Configuration variable parsing
features.description: The gem5 backend shall extract configuration metadata derived from simulation paths using explicit path index selection.

features.title: Pattern aggregation
features.description: A regex statistic matching several simulator values shall aggregate according to the variable type while retaining traceable source semantics.

features.title: Simple parsing strategy
features.description: The simple parsing strategy shall parse matching statistics files without requiring configuration metadata.

features.title: Config-aware parsing strategy
features.description: The config-aware strategy shall require valid config.ini input and add deterministic sim_path and compact key-sorted config_json columns.

features.title: Asynchronous parse lifecycle
features.description: Parsing shall support submit, owned futures, finalize, cancellation, strict missing-stat handling, and safe temporary-output cleanup through ParseJob.

features.title: Visible missing and failed parse values
features.description: Parsing shall expose failed files and missing statistics and represent unavailable simulator values as NaN rather than fabricating zeroes.

features.title: Parse output and provenance
features.description: Successful parsing shall assemble a CSV and retain stats path, pattern, selected variables, scanned variables, and strategy context for later restoration.

features.title: Dataset summary
features.description: Users shall inspect row, column, memory, missing-value, type, numeric, and categorical summaries of the active dataset.

features.title: Searchable paginated table view
features.description: Users shall search literal text across one or all columns, select visible columns, paginate rows, and download the current filtered view as CSV.

features.title: Preview before dataset replacement
features.description: Dataset managers shall place candidate results in an isolated preview and replace workspace data only after explicit user confirmation.

features.title: Repeated-run reduction
features.description: Users shall reduce repeated seeds or runs by selected categorical groups and numeric statistics, producing means and companion .sd columns.

features.title: Grouped IQR outlier removal
features.description: Users shall remove numeric values outside 1.5-IQR fences globally or independently within selected categorical groups.

features.title: Binary arithmetic columns
features.description: Users shall derive a named numeric column from two existing columns using division, sum, subtraction, or multiplication.

features.title: Numeric column mixer
features.description: Users shall combine multiple numeric columns into a named sum or arithmetic mean column.

features.title: Configuration label mixer
features.description: Users shall concatenate multiple columns with a configurable separator to create a combined configuration label.

features.title: Mixer error propagation
features.description: When source columns have .sd or _stdev companions, numeric mixing shall propagate uncertainty into a companion output standard deviation.

features.title: Dataset operation history
features.description: Confirmed manager operations shall be recorded, reviewable, reloadable into controls, and individually removable.

features.title: Independent per-plot pipelines
features.description: Each plot shall own an ordered shaper pipeline whose output does not mutate workspace data or another plot.

features.title: Pipeline editing and finalization
features.description: Users shall add, configure, reorder, remove, preview, and explicitly finalize shaper steps before plotting.

features.title: Mean shaper
features.description: The mean shaper shall append arithmetic, geometric, or harmonic summary rows for selected variables and groups.

features.title: Column selector shaper
features.description: The column selector shall retain an explicitly ordered subset of input columns.

features.title: Condition selector shaper
features.description: The condition selector shall filter rows by equality, containment, comparison, explicit values, or numeric range.

features.title: Item selector shaper
features.description: The item selector shall keep rows whose selected column exactly matches or contains configured string values.

features.title: Group cardinality selector shaper
features.description: The group cardinality selector shall retain groups when the distinct-value count of a configured column equals, exceeds, or falls below a configured threshold.

features.title: Group predicate selector shaper
features.description: The group predicate selector shall keep or drop whole groups according to whether a configured baseline row contains zero, NaN, or either in a selected predicate column.

features.title: Normalization shaper
features.description: The normalize shaper shall divide selected variables and optional .sd companions by a non-zero baseline within each configured group.

features.title: Pivot-longer shaper
features.description: The pivot-longer shaper shall melt selected columns and optionally extract, select, discard, or merge pattern-derived categories.

features.title: Pivot-wider shaper
features.description: The pivot-wider shaper shall reshape a long table into indexed columns from configured names and values.

features.title: Explicit sort shaper
features.description: The sort shaper shall reorder rows using explicit category orders for one or more columns.

features.title: Split-apply shaper
features.description: The split-apply shaper shall partition data by join columns, apply independent nested pipelines, and merge the results.

features.title: Type transformer shaper
features.description: The transformer shaper shall convert a column to a supported type and optionally enforce categorical order.

features.title: Derived-column shaper
features.description: The derive-column shaper shall create or replace a column through sum, ratio, scalar arithmetic, concatenation, or value mapping.

features.title: Create and select multiple plots
features.description: Users shall create named plots of registered types and select among all plots in the current workspace.

features.title: Rename plots
features.description: Users shall rename an existing plot without changing its configuration, pipeline, or data.

features.title: Duplicate plots
features.description: Users shall duplicate a plot into independent copied configuration, pipeline, and processed data state.

features.title: Delete plots
features.description: Users shall remove a plot and its derived state without corrupting the remaining workspace plots.

features.title: Independent plot state
features.description: Each plot shall retain independent data mapping, styling, pipeline, legend mapping, and cached render state, while the session engine participates in the cache identity.

features.title: Automatic refresh and render caching
features.description: Users shall choose automatic or manual figure refresh, and unchanged plot inputs shall reuse an engine-aware render cache.

features.title: Bar chart
features.description: RING-5 shall render one numeric measure by category as vertical bars with optional color grouping and error bars.

features.title: Dual-axis bar and dot chart
features.description: RING-5 shall combine grouped primary-axis bars with independently styled secondary-axis dots and optional connecting lines.

features.title: Grouped bar chart
features.description: RING-5 shall render side-by-side bars for comparison groups within each major category.

features.title: Grouped stacked bar chart
features.description: RING-5 shall render stacked components nested within comparison groups and support optional right-axis series.

features.title: Heatmap
features.description: RING-5 shall render numeric values across row and column categories as a color-encoded matrix with optional facets.

features.title: Histogram
features.description: RING-5 shall render observation distributions or parsed gem5 bucket columns with configurable bins, grouping, stacking, and normalization.

features.title: Line chart
features.description: RING-5 shall render ordered trends with configurable lines, markers, grouping, and error bars.

features.title: Scatter plot
features.description: RING-5 shall render the relationship between two numeric measures with optional categorical color grouping.

features.title: Stacked bar chart
features.description: RING-5 shall render multiple numeric components stacked into a total for each category.

features.title: Figure layout and dimensions
features.description: Users shall configure publication presets, width, height, DPI, margins, bar width, and group gaps.

features.title: Typography configuration
features.description: Users shall configure font family and title, axis-title, tick-label, legend, annotation, and data-label typography.

features.title: Axis configuration
features.description: Users shall configure axis titles, ranges, tick steps, tick angles, tick marks, axis lines, and left or right axis styling where applicable.

features.title: Legend configuration
features.description: Users shall configure applicable primary, secondary, and numbered legends, including position, orientation, anchors, columns, fonts, backgrounds, borders, markers, and spacing.

features.title: Color and palette configuration
features.description: Users shall choose registered colorblind-aware palettes or explicit colors and configure plot, paper, grid, and axis colors with optional transparent backgrounds.

features.title: Data value labels
features.description: Users shall show formatted data values with configurable color mode, font size, rotation, position, anchor, threshold logic, and size constraint.

features.title: Progressive advanced settings
features.description: Layout, typography, and legends shall remain directly accessible while axes, labels, colors, and advanced controls can be progressively disclosed.

features.title: Standard-deviation error bars
features.description: Plots that support uncertainty shall optionally render error bars from companion .sd columns on both rendering engines.

features.title: Reference lines
features.description: Users shall add and style horizontal reference lines, including normalized baselines, with position, color, width, style, and label.

features.title: Shapes and text annotations
features.description: Users and scripts shall add engine-independent text annotations and line, rectangle, or other supported shape decorations.

features.title: Category ordering and relabeling
features.description: Users shall reorder and rename applicable X categories, groups, legend items, stack series, Y metrics, and facets without rewriting source data.

features.title: Grouped-category separators
features.description: Grouped plots shall optionally draw category separators and isolate the final group with a configurable gap or divider.

features.title: Numbered X-axis labels
features.description: Grouped figures shall optionally replace or supplement long category labels with numbers and a separately configurable number legend.

features.title: Category super-groups
features.description: Grouped figures shall optionally combine adjacent categories into labeled super-groups with boundaries and span rules.

features.title: Dual-axis configuration
features.description: Applicable plots shall expose right-axis mappings, range, title, dot or bar mode, marker and line styling, per-group lines, and unified or separate legends.

features.title: Histogram configuration
features.description: Histogram plots shall expose observation or pre-binned input, binning, group, stack or overlay, and count, probability, density, or percent normalization controls.

features.title: Heatmap configuration
features.description: Heatmap plots shall expose matrix mappings, optional facets, color scale, range, colorbar, missing-cell, and cell-label controls.

features.title: Interactive Plotly editing
features.description: Plotly figures shall optionally accept zoom, pan, legend movement, and editable text events and persist supported relayout changes into plot configuration.

features.title: Engine-independent trace construction
features.description: Every plot type shall build typed engine-independent traces before either rendering connector is invoked.

features.title: Plotly rendering engine
features.description: RING-5 shall render all registered plot traces as interactive Plotly figures.

features.title: Matplotlib rendering engine
features.description: RING-5 shall render all registered plot traces as static Matplotlib figures.

features.title: Per-plot engine selection
features.description: Users shall switch each plot between Plotly and Matplotlib, with engine-specific controls and export formats synchronized before rendering.

features.title: Self-contained Plotly HTML export
features.description: Plotly figures shall export as self-contained interactive HTML without requiring a browser executable.

features.title: Static Plotly export
features.description: Plotly figures shall export through Kaleido and a Chrome-family browser as PNG, SVG, or PDF with bounded retries for transient browser failures.

features.title: Standard Matplotlib export
features.description: Matplotlib figures shall export as PDF, PNG, or SVG with appropriate physical dimensions and raster DPI.

features.title: Matplotlib PGF export
features.description: Matplotlib figures shall export as XeLaTeX-compatible PGF, preserving configured figure size and falling back visibly when raster content prevents PGF output.

features.title: Engine-aware web downloads
features.description: The plot page shall expose only formats supported by the selected engine and generate a correctly named downloadable artifact.

features.title: Deterministic exports
features.description: Headless exports shall optionally normalize engine-specific identifiers, timestamps, and salts so repeated exports are byte-stable where supported.

features.title: Public byte and file export API
features.description: The public API shall infer a figure engine, validate formats, return bytes or write files, create parent directories, and expose typed dependency and export failures.

features.title: Portfolio save
features.description: Users shall save a named snapshot containing the available workspace data, plots, processed plot data, pipelines, figure configuration, parse provenance, counters, and histories; a configuration-only snapshot shall remain valid when no data is loaded.

features.title: Explicit portfolio overwrite
features.description: Headless portfolio saving shall refuse to replace an existing named snapshot unless overwrite is explicitly requested.

features.title: Portfolio restore
features.description: Users shall load a named portfolio and restore every compatible data, plot, pipeline, configuration, provenance, and history item into the current session.

features.title: Visible partial restoration
features.description: Portfolio restoration shall return or display a structured report of data errors, skipped plots, and malformed parser variables instead of silently dropping content.

features.title: Portfolio schema migration
features.description: Older supported portfolio schemas shall migrate deterministically before restoration, while newer unknown schemas shall fail with a typed version error.

features.title: Portfolio listing and deletion
features.description: The web application shall list saved portfolios and allow intentional deletion of an individual snapshot.

features.title: Headless portfolio replay
features.description: The public API and CLI shall restore, render, and export every valid plot in a portfolio through a selected engine and format.

features.title: Safe portfolio upgrade
features.description: The CLI shall refuse to re-save a partially restored portfolio because doing so would permanently discard skipped content.

features.title: Headless Session workspace
features.description: The supported Session context manager shall compose scan, parse, load, manage, shape, plot, render, export, and portfolio operations and release owned pending work on close.

features.title: Pandas-independent Table scripts
features.description: The public Table and read_table surface shall provide immutable loading, selection, transformation, inspection, and export for scripts that do not import pandas.

features.title: Typed FigureSpec
features.description: The public API shall expose typed common figure mappings, layout, axes, grouping, legend, reference-line, and dual-axis configuration with an extra-key escape hatch.

features.title: Fluent FigureSpec builder
features.description: Scripts shall build a FigureSpec through cohesive fluent methods for data, size, palettes, axes, grouping, legends, references, and dual-axis options.

features.title: Scripted coordinates and decorations
features.description: Scripts shall calculate grouped-bar coordinates and add engine-independent annotations and shapes without importing internal rendering modules.

features.title: Public registry discovery
features.description: Scripts shall discover current stable plot and shaper identifiers instead of copying registry inventories.

features.title: Typed public errors
features.description: Supported operational failures shall inherit Ring5Error and expose narrower scan, parse, pipeline, data, render, export, dependency, and portfolio error types.

features.title: Dependency doctor
features.description: The public API and CLI shall report essential Perl and optional browser and XeLaTeX dependency availability without making optional exporters mandatory.

features.title: CLI parsing
features.description: The ring5 parse command shall parse repeated variable arguments from a stats tree into a requested durable CSV with strict or lenient missing-stat behavior.

features.title: CLI portfolio rendering
features.description: The ring5 render command shall regenerate all portfolio figures into a target directory with selectable engine, format, and deterministic mode.

features.title: Reusable worker-pool lifecycle
features.description: Process-wide parser and scan pools shall remain reusable across sessions, support explicit shutdown, and restart transparently when used again.

features.title: Runtime plot registration
features.description: New BasePlot implementations shall register stable snake-case identifiers and UI metadata through the plot factory.

features.title: Shaper factory registration
features.description: New pure shapers shall register stable serialized identifiers, typed configurations, UI configuration, and pipeline validation through the shaper factory.

features.title: Simulator parser protocol
features.description: Additional simulators shall integrate through the SimulationParser protocol and simulator registry without adding simulator-specific logic to core services.

features.title: Rendering connector protocol
features.description: Rendering engines shall consume the canonical FigureConfig and typed traces through a common connector boundary.

features.title: Non-mutating DataFrame operations
features.description: Core managers, shapers, and public table operations shall return new data objects and preserve caller-owned inputs.

features.title: Layered architecture boundaries
features.description: Core and parsing code shall remain independent of Streamlit, core shall not import web composition, and presentation shall depend inward through explicit facades and protocols.

features.title: Bounded and sanitized input
features.description: File names, paths, regular expressions, text searches, uploads, and aggregate operations shall be validated, contained, and bounded before expensive or persistent work.

features.title: Owned asynchronous work
features.description: Scan and parse batches shall expose ownership, cancellation, timeout, resource ceilings, and cleanup without allowing one session to cancel or delete another session's work.

features.title: Configurable application-data directory
features.description: RING-5 shall keep CSV-pool, saved-configuration, and portfolio files below one application-data directory that defaults to .ring5 and can be redirected with RING5_DATA_DIR.

features.title: Automatic CSV delimiter detection
features.description: CSV loading through the data service shall detect common delimiters, cache immutable copies and metadata, and expose rows, columns, types, size, and modification time for recent files.

features.title: Authorized web statistics roots
features.description: Browser-submitted statistics paths shall be resolved below the roots configured by RING5_ALLOWED_STATS_ROOTS, and the Data Source page shall display the active roots.

features.title: Quick and deep scan progress
features.description: The web workflow shall offer bounded quick and deep scan presets, show per-file progress, surface scan failures and timeouts, and release only settled work owned by that application instance.

features.title: Pattern index selection and preservation
features.description: For statistics containing one or more numeric pattern positions, users shall filter discovered index values and optionally preserve each selected concrete instance as an independent output column.

features.title: Statistics-only structured parsing
features.description: Vector, distribution, and histogram configurations shall choose statistics only, entries only, or entries plus statistics so wide bucket or entry sets can be omitted intentionally.

features.title: Structured variable entry and summary selection
features.description: Users shall select discovered or manually named vector and histogram entries and choose supported totals, means, geometric means, samples, deviations, underflows, and overflows where the variable type provides them.

features.title: Deep distribution range discovery
features.description: A deep scan shall aggregate the global minimum and maximum distribution bucket range across its bounded sample and make those values available to the variable configuration.

features.title: Histogram bucket rebinning
features.description: Histogram variables shall optionally normalize inconsistent source ranges into a configured number of fixed buckets and maximum range before CSV assembly.

features.title: Persistent parser worker pool
features.description: gem5 parsing shall reuse a bounded pool of persistent Perl workers with request timeouts, health monitoring, restart, statistics, and orderly shutdown.

features.title: Parser output aliases
features.description: Users shall assign a logical output alias to a scalar or pattern variable without changing the source statistic used for discovery and parsing, and duplicate source or alias definitions shall fail visibly.

features.title: Configuration metadata fallbacks
features.description: Configuration variables shall accept an explicit onEmpty value and use it when path-derived metadata is absent while preserving the first extracted value when content exists.

features.title: Saved shaper configurations
features.description: The application data service shall save, list, load, and delete named shaper-pipeline configurations with descriptions and an optional associated CSV path.

features.title: Plot-configuration category filters
features.description: Applicable plot mappings shall let users restrict visible X categories and groups without changing the processed plot table or workspace dataset.

features.title: Stack total annotations
features.description: Stacked and grouped-stacked plots shall optionally label stack totals with configurable numeric format, threshold, typography, position, anchor, offset, and rotation.

features.title: Heatmap totals and threshold labels
features.description: Heatmaps shall optionally add a total row, reverse their color scale, and show all, above-threshold, or below-threshold formatted cell labels with configurable missing-cell text.

features.title: Cumulative histogram display
features.description: Histogram plots shall optionally accumulate bins in display order while preserving the selected count, probability, density, or percent normalization semantics.

features.title: Matplotlib TeX-system selection
features.description: Matplotlib-specific advanced settings shall select XeLaTeX, pdfLaTeX, or LuaLaTeX while keeping arbitrary preamble injection disabled in the web interface.

features.title: Plotly hover behavior
features.description: Plotly-specific settings shall choose unified X, closest-point, X, Y, or disabled hover behavior and preserve that choice in the engine-independent figure configuration.

features.title: Change an existing plot type
features.description: Users shall switch an existing plot to another registered type while preserving its identity, pipeline, and processed data and resetting type-specific mappings and figure settings.

features.title: Alternate category shading
features.description: Grouped and grouped-stacked bar charts shall optionally shade alternating major categories with a selected color while retaining category separators and isolation spacing.

features.title: Per-series visual styling
features.description: Applicable plots shall style individual series with an override color, display name, bar pattern, marker symbol and size, line width, opacity, and border settings while allowing a series to return to its palette default.

features.title: Plotly raster export scale
features.description: Plotly static downloads shall support one-, two-, or three-times export scale and apply the selected scale when producing the downloadable artifact.

features.title: Public plot mapping validation
features.description: The public plotting boundary shall reject unknown plot types, missing or mistyped mappings, absent referenced columns, and invalid engine choices before registering or rendering a plot.

features.title: Data-manager extension contract
features.description: New shared-dataset operations shall place pure validation and transformation in the managers service family, delegate through the facade, and use preview-confirm UI state before replacement.

features.title: Figure-settings extension contract
features.description: New figure controls shall use typed canonical configuration where shared, renderer resolution and both connectors, stable widget keys, and the registered settings-section composition.

features.title: Single application facade contract
features.description: Web features shall reach state, managers, data services, shapers, and parser submission through one session-owned ApplicationAPI whose three focused sub-APIs delegate to concrete services.

features.title: Bounded thread-safe caching
features.description: CSV metadata, loaded frames, and expensive shaper results shall use thread-safe caches with bounded size, expiry or content fingerprints, defensive result isolation, statistics, and explicit clearing.

features.title: Safe numeric and LaTeX output formatting
features.description: User-controlled numeric formats and figure text shall be bounded or escaped before formatting and TeX export so malformed formats and TeX commands cannot execute or exhaust resources.

features.title: Performance regression gates
features.description: Representative large-data, cache, worker-pool, transformation, and rendering workflows shall have repeatable performance checks with explicit regression thresholds.

features.title: Deterministic OFT inventory generator
features.description: A repository tool shall validate feature IDs, revisions, statuses, evidence paths, and deterministic generated OpenFastTrace Markdown.

features.title: Repeatable discovery convergence audit
features.description: The repository shall record independent feature-discovery passes, their accepted deltas and rejected candidates, and repeat the audit until a pass adds no current requirements.

features.title: Native OFT HTML coverage report
features.description: A single command shall generate native OpenFastTrace HTML, derive coverage outcomes from OFT trace results, provide requirement search and filters, and retain the complete OFT artifact graph in the standalone report.

features.title: Live capability drift detection
features.description: The quality gate shall fail when navigation, registries, parser and shaper schemas, rendering models and formats, public APIs, Session methods, or CLI commands and options lack an explicit requirement binding.
